TeamCity On-Premises 2026.2 Help

Previous Releases Downloads

The latest TeamCity release is available on the official download page. There, you can also find links to TeamCity Docker images.

If you are upgrading, please ensure all your licenses will be still valid with the new version. A license is valid if its maintenance period covers the release date of the last major version release (the release date that is marked in bold below). Note that you are automatically licensed to receive all the following minor bugfix versions for the last major version covered by your maintenance period.

  • For all downloads, you can get the SHA256 checksum: just add .sha256 to the download URL.

  • Windows installer can also be downloaded archived: replace .exe in the link to the installer with -installer.zip.

See also: Documentation for Previous Versions and Roadmap Outline.
